class.name: CgameLocomotionTools
class.brief_description: Distance matching, stride and orientation warping, attack motion warping.
class.description: [CgameLocomotionTools] contains small pure helpers for locomotion: finding the playback time of a stopping or starting animation that matches a remaining distance, scaling playback speed to the actual speed, splitting a facing/velocity mismatch into lower and upper body yaw, solving a short attack lunge towards a target, and computing the pelvis drop for foot placement.

method.name: motion_warp_solve
method.description: Finds the nearest target in a 60 degree cone around [param direction] within [param reach] plus a margin. Returns [code]offset[/code] ([Vector3] lunge) and [code]yaw[/code], or an empty dictionary.

method.name: orientation_warp
method.description: Returns [code]lower_body_yaw[/code] and [code]upper_body_yaw[/code] (opposite sign) that align the legs with the movement direction.

method.name: pelvis_offset
method.description: Returns the (non-positive, at most 0.25 m) pelvis offset needed to reach the lower foot target.

method.name: playback_time_for_distance
method.description: Looks up the animation time at which the distance curve reaches [param remaining_distance] using binary search and linear interpolation. The curve may be ascending or descending.

method.name: stride_play_rate
method.description: Returns the playback rate that matches the authored stride to the actual speed.
